papers.title: A subtype-specific gene regulatory program controls differential circuit integration of deep CA3 pyramidal neurons
papers.translated_title: 亚型特异性基因调控程序控制深层CA3锥体神经元的差异性环路整合
papers.author: Daaboul, D.
papers.summary: How closely related neuronal subtypes integrate into different circuits remains poorly understood. Deep and superficial hippocampal CA3 pyramidal neurons (PNs) differ in intrinsic firing and mossy fiber (MF) input at specialized postsynaptic structures termed thorny excrescences (TEs). Combining developmental single-nucleus multiomics with genetic targeting, morphological analysis and electrophysiology, we identify the transcription factor ST18 as a regulator of deep CA3 subtype identity. ST18 marks sparsely thorny and burst-firing neurons, and gene regulatory analyses predict that it represses a superficial-associated program involved in dendritic spine development, synaptic organization, and electrophysiological properties. Postnatal ST18 loss shifts the transcriptional and chromatin landscape of deep CA3 PNs toward a superficial-like state. These molecular changes are accompanied by increased TE elaboration approaching superficial levels, enhanced excitatory synaptic activity, and reduced burst-firing. Together, these findings identify ST18-dependent restriction of an alternative subtype program as a mechanism linking molecular identity to distinct input connectivity patterns and intrinsic firing properties during postnatal circuit maturation.
papers.translated_summary: 神经元亚型如何紧密相关地整合到不同环路中仍知之甚少。深部与浅部海马CA3锥体神经元（PNs）在内在放电特性以及被称为棘状突起（TEs）的特化突触后结构处接受苔藓纤维（MF）输入方面存在差异。结合发育期单核多组学与遗传靶向、形态学分析和电生理学，我们鉴定转录因子ST18为深部CA3亚型身份的调控因子。ST18标记棘状突起稀疏且呈爆发式放电的神经元，基因调控分析预测其抑制一个与浅部相关、参与树突棘发育、突触组织和电生理特性的程序。出生后ST18缺失使深部CA3 PNs的转录和染色质景观向浅部样状态转变。这些分子变化伴随棘状突起 elaboration 增加并接近浅部水平、兴奋性突触活动增强以及爆发式放电减少。总之，这些发现鉴定出ST18依赖性地限制一个替代亚型程序，作为出生后环路成熟过程中将分子身份与特定输入连接模式和内在放电特性联系起来的机制。

papers.title: Learning to play with spikes: characterizing, predicting, and engineering unsupervised plasticity rules for spiking reservoir computing
papers.translated_title: 学习与脉冲共舞：刻画、预测与设计脉冲储备池计算中的无监督可塑性规则
papers.author: Kania, M.
papers.summary: Spiking reservoir computing, and reservoir computing more generally, is a powerful and efficient framework for neuromorphic and biological applications, in which a fixed random reservoir drives a trained readout. Its performance depends critically on the reservoir initialization, so that enriching the reservoir with adaptive, unsupervised plasticity rules offers a natural solution to this limitation. However, it is unclear which rules work, or why, and how to find the best-suited rules for specific tasks without exhaustive and expensive search. Here, we learn how to play the Atari game Pong in a plastic spiking reservoir network. We systematically characterize a large family of local plasticity rules that were meta-learned in prior work. We then show that their performance is predictable and structured: high-scoring rules are characterized by strong differentiation between neurons encoding the ball trajectory and the background, with stable weight dynamics, and consistent readout alignment across time. These mechanistic signatures are not task-specific and transfer to a delayed-match recognition task. Rule performance can be estimated from rule parameters alone. Finally, conditioning simulation-based inference (SBI) on high scores allows us to sample directly from promising regions of the rule space, to discover rules that exceed the performance of those found in the prior distribution and reveal stable, high-performing configurations. Together, these results offer competitive performance against classical reservoir computing while providing a transparent, interpretable account of what makes a plasticity rule useful for neuromorphic hardware and biological computing.
papers.translated_summary: 脉冲储层计算，以及更一般意义上的储层计算，是神经形态与生物应用中强大而高效的框架，其中固定的随机储层驱动一个经过训练的输出读出。其性能关键取决于储层的初始化，因此用自适应、无监督的可塑性规则来丰富储层，为这一局限提供了自然的解决方案。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些规则有效、为何有效，以及如何在不进行穷尽且昂贵的搜索的情况下，为特定任务找到最合适的规则。在这里，我们学习如何在一个可塑的脉冲储层网络中玩Atari游戏Pong。我们系统地刻画了先前工作中通过元学习得到的一大类局部可塑性规则。随后我们表明，它们的性能是可预测且结构化的：高分规则的特征在于，编码球轨迹的神经元与背景之间存在强烈区分、权重动态稳定，以及读出在不同时间上保持一致对齐。这些机制性特征并非任务特异，并可迁移到一个延迟匹配识别任务。规则性能可以仅从规则参数估计。最后，将基于模拟的推断（SBI）以高分作为条件，使我们能够直接从规则空间中有希望的区域采样，从而发现性能超过先前分布中所发现规则的规则，并揭示稳定、高性能的配置。总之，这些结果在提供与经典储层计算相竞争的性能的同时，对是什么使一条可塑性规则对神经形态硬件和生物计算有用，给出了透明、可解释的说明。

papers.title: FMRP safeguards long mRNA expression by opposing repressive RNP states
papers.translated_title: FMRP通过对抗抑制性RNP状态来保障长mRNA的表达
papers.author: Ma, K.
papers.summary: Fragile X messenger ribonucleoprotein (FMRP) is widely viewed as a translational repressor, yet its loss paradoxically compromises expression of exceptionally long, dosage-sensitive neurodevelopmental mRNAs. First shown in Drosophila oocytes, this selective loss extends to mouse cortex and hippocampus, but its mechanism remains unknown. Here, we uncover a protective function for FMRP: shielding long mRNAs from repression by Me31B/DDX6, a conserved RNA helicase that organizes repressive RNP complexes. In Drosophila oocytes, FMRP loss redirects target mRNAs into Me31B-marked P-bodies. Transcriptome-wide binding maps reveal extensive FMRP-Me31B co-occupancy, preferentially concentrated on long coding sequences whose translation depends on FMRP. Strikingly, disrupting Me31B-dependent repression preferentially enhances translation of FMRP targets in FMRP-deficient oocytes. We identify Rin/G3BP, Caprin, and Lig/UBAP2L as FMRP-associated cofactors supporting expression of distinct targets. Together, our findings challenge the prevailing view of FMRP as a translational repressor, revealing instead a mechanism that safeguards vulnerable neurodevelopmental mRNAs from inappropriate cytoplasmic silencing.
papers.translated_summary: 脆性X信使核糖核蛋白（FMRP）被广泛视为一种翻译抑制因子，然而其缺失却矛盾地损害了异常长且对剂量敏感的神经发育mRNA的表达。这一选择性损失最初在果蝇卵母细胞中被发现，随后扩展至小鼠皮层和海马体，但其机制仍不清楚。在此，我们揭示了FMRP的一种保护功能：保护长mRNA免受Me31B/DDX6的抑制，后者是一种组织抑制性RNP复合物的保守RNA解旋酶。在果蝇卵母细胞中，FMRP缺失将靶mRNA重定向至Me31B标记的P小体。转录组范围的结合图谱揭示FMRP与Me31B广泛共占据，优先集中于翻译依赖于FMRP的长编码序列上。引人注目的是，破坏Me31B依赖性抑制优先增强了FMRP缺陷卵母细胞中FMRP靶标的翻译。我们鉴定出Rin/G3BP、Caprin和Lig/UBAP2L作为FMRP相关辅因子，支持不同靶标的表达。总之，我们的发现挑战了FMRP作为翻译抑制因子的主流观点，转而揭示了一种保护脆弱神经发育mRNA免于不当胞质沉默的机制。

papers.title: Integrated genomics and transcriptomics reveal molecular insights into extreme dietary adaptation in vampire bats
papers.translated_title: 综合基因组学与转录组学揭示吸血蝙蝠极端食性适应的分子机制
papers.author: Liu, S.
papers.summary: Vampire bats are the only tetrapods that feed exclusively on blood. To uncover the molecular changes associated with this extreme dietary specialization, we generated six new reference genomes, including genomes of all three vampire bat species, and integrated comparative analyses of gene sequence evolution (selection signatures, duplications, and losses) with transcriptomic data from six major organs to identify shifts in gene expression. Our integrative analyses reveal sequence or expression changes in 150 genes that provide insights into the molecular biology of sanguivory. Through comparative analyses and experiments, we show that the enlarged vampire bat stomach has increased connective tissue content, likely facilitating extreme expansion, is pH-neutral, and exhibits reduced mucus production, together providing molecular insights into its shift from a digestive to an absorptive organ for water, electrolytes, and vitamins. We further uncover pathway-level molecular changes associated with altered gastrointestinal motility; trypsin-dependent protein digestion; upregulated amino acid catabolism with key aspects diverging from other mammals; impaired dietary fat digestion counterbalanced by increased fatty acid synthesis; defective sugar metabolism and natural insulin deficiency; enhanced heme iron absorption; and adult splenic erythropoiesis. Together, these findings provide an integrated view of molecular changes associated with one of the most extreme dietary transitions among vertebrates.
papers.translated_summary: 吸血蝙蝠是唯一完全以血液为食的四足动物。为了揭示与这一极端食性特化相关的分子变化，我们生成了六个新的参考基因组，包括全部三种吸血蝙蝠的基因组，并将基因序列进化比较分析（选择特征、重复和丢失）与来自六个主要器官的转录组数据相结合，以识别基因表达的变化。我们的综合分析揭示了150个基因的序列或表达变化，为食血性的分子生物学提供了见解。通过比较分析和实验，我们发现增大的吸血蝙蝠胃具有增加的结缔组织含量，可能促进极端扩张，呈pH中性，并表现出减少的黏液产生，这些共同为其从消化器官转变为吸收水、电解质和维生素的器官提供了分子层面的见解。我们进一步揭示了与以下方面相关的通路水平分子变化：改变的胃肠动力；胰蛋白酶依赖性蛋白质消化；上调的氨基酸分解代谢，其关键方面与其他哺乳动物不同；受损的膳食脂肪消化由增加的脂肪酸合成所抵消；缺陷的糖代谢和天然胰岛素缺乏；增强的血红素铁吸收；以及成年脾脏红细胞生成。总之，这些发现为与脊椎动物中最极端的食性转变之一相关的分子变化提供了综合视角。

papers.title: Open-source benchmarking of dairy and dairy-free products
papers.translated_title: 乳制品及非乳制品的开源基准测试
papers.author: Koosis, A. O.
papers.summary: Dairy-free products offer opportunities to reduce the environmental impact of food. However, they must reproduce the diverse sensory and functional properties of conventional dairy, from foam stabilization in a latte to acid-gel structure in yogurt and melt--stretch behavior in mozzarella. Yet, large-scale, open-source sensory benchmarks across dairy product categories remain scarce. Here we show that the sensory gap between dairy and dairy-free products varies substantially across ten categories: barista milk, butter, cheddar, cream cheese, creamer, ice cream, fluid milk, mozzarella, sour cream, and Greek-style yogurt. We analyze the NECTAR Taste of the Industry 2026 dataset, which includes 1,437 respondents, 3,220 overall-liking ratings, and 79,027 recorded survey responses, including 35,762 product-linked responses. Leading dairy-free beverages, barista milk ($+0.17$), fluid milk ($+0.02$), and creamer ($-0.06$), closely approach their dairy benchmarks in overall liking on a seven-point scale. In contrast, mozzarella shows the largest deficit ($-1.46$), followed by Greek-style yogurt ($-0.68$) and butter ($-0.54$). All three deficits remain statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. Across categories, descriptive penalty analysis identifies off-flavor (1.85 points), stale or cardboard notes (1.81 points), and artificial or chemical notes (1.80 points) as the sensory attributes associated with the largest reductions in overall liking. Together, these results establish the first open sensory benchmark for dairy and dairy-free products, identify beverage categories that approach conventional dairy in overall liking, and reveal the sensory attributes and product categories with the greatest opportunities for future innovation.
papers.translated_summary: 无乳制品为减少食品的环境影响提供了机会。然而，它们必须复现传统乳制品的多样感官和功能特性，从拿铁中的泡沫稳定性到酸奶中的酸凝胶结构，再到马苏里拉奶酪的融化-拉伸行为。然而，跨乳制品类别的大规模、开源感官基准仍然稀缺。在此，我们表明乳制品与无乳制品之间的感官差距在十个类别中差异显著：咖啡师奶、黄油、切达奶酪、奶油奶酪、植脂奶精、冰淇淋、液态奶、马苏里拉奶酪、酸奶油和希腊式酸奶。我们分析了 NECTAR Taste of the Industry 2026 数据集，该数据集包括 1,437 名受访者、3,220 个总体喜好度评分和 79,027 条记录的调查回复，其中包括 35,762 条与产品关联的回复。领先的无乳制品饮料——咖啡师奶（+0.17）、液态奶（+0.02）和植脂奶精（-0.06）——在七分制总体喜好度上接近其乳制品基准。相比之下，马苏里拉奶酪的差距最大（-1.46），其次是希腊式酸奶（-0.68）和黄油（-0.54）。经多重比较校正后，这三项差距均具有统计学显著性。跨类别而言，描述性惩罚分析将异味（1.85 分）、陈旧或纸板味（1.81 分）以及人工或化学味（1.80 分）识别为与总体喜好度下降幅度最大的感官属性。总之，这些结果建立了首个乳制品与无乳制品的开源感官基准，识别出在总体喜好度上接近传统乳制品的饮料类别，并揭示了未来创新机会最大的感官属性和产品类别。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Protein-Ligand Binding Site Prediction from Protein Sequence and SMILES
papers.translated_title: 从蛋白质序列和SMILES进行零样本蛋白质-配体结合位点预测
papers.author: Pourmirzaei, M.
papers.summary: Accurate identification of protein-ligand binding sites is critical for mechanistic biology and drug discovery, yet predictive performance varies substantially across ligand families and data-availability regimes. We present a systematic ligand-aware benchmark and evaluation framework for residue-level binding-site prediction across three settings: overrepresented ligands with abundant examples, underrepresented ligands with limited examples, and zero-shot ligands unseen during training. Using a BioLiP2-derived dataset with ligand-specific sequence clustering, we evaluate a progressive three-stage sequence-based modeling suite designed to study these regimes. Stage 1 trains ligand-specific predictors using a pretrained protein language model (PLM). Stage 2 introduces ligand conditioning through learned embeddings, enabling a single multi-ligand model. Stage 3 replaces these embeddings with representations from a pretrained chemical language model (CLM) operating on SMILES, enabling prediction for previously unseen ligands. In the original three-stage comparison, Stage 2 achieved a higher ligand-macro F1 than Stage 1 on the overrepresented test set (0.5832 versus 0.4769), although the comparison simultaneously changes predictor architecture, ligand conditioning, and the training regime. Stage 2 also outperformed several sequence- and structure-based baselines. Stage 3 achieves a pooled residue-level F1 of 0.3109 and a ligand-macro F1 of 0.2338 on previously unseen ligands, while remaining competitive on represented ligands. Control experiments using constant, mismatched, and scrambled SMILES inputs reduce performance across all three test regimes, providing evidence that the model uses information associated with the supplied ligand input rather than relying solely on generic protein binding-site propensity. Ablations across five PLM scales and multiple CLMs further show that increasing PLM scale generally improves performance, although the trend is not strictly monotonic, whereas CLM scaling produces smaller and less consistent gains. Overall, this study provides a systematic benchmark for quantifying the effect of ligand data availability on residue-level binding-site prediction and for evaluating generalization to previously unseen ligands.
papers.translated_summary: 准确识别蛋白质-配体结合位点对于机制生物学和药物发现至关重要，但预测性能在不同配体家族和数据可用性条件下存在显著差异。我们提出了一个系统的配体感知基准和评估框架，用于在三种设置下进行残基级结合位点预测：具有丰富样本的过代表配体、具有有限样本的低代表配体，以及训练期间未见过的零样本配体。使用源自BioLiP2并具有配体特异性序列聚类的数据集，我们评估了一个渐进式三阶段基于序列的建模套件，旨在研究这些情形。阶段1使用预训练蛋白质语言模型（PLM）训练配体特异性预测器。阶段2通过学习到的嵌入引入配体条件化，从而能够构建单一多配体模型。阶段3用基于SMILES运行的预训练化学语言模型（CLM）的表示替换这些嵌入，从而能够对先前未见过的配体进行预测。在原始的三阶段比较中，阶段2在过代表测试集上取得了高于阶段1的配体宏F1（0.5832对0.4769），尽管该比较同时改变了预测器架构、配体条件化和训练机制。阶段2也优于若干基于序列和基于结构的基线。阶段3在先前未见过的配体上取得了0.3109的汇总残基级F1和0.2338的配体宏F1，同时在已代表配体上保持竞争力。使用恒定、错配和打乱的SMILES输入进行的对照实验降低了所有三种测试情形下的性能，提供了证据表明模型使用了与所提供配体输入相关的信息，而不是仅依赖一般性的蛋白质结合位点倾向。跨五个PLM规模和多个CLM的消融进一步表明，增加PLM规模通常会提高性能，尽管该趋势并非严格单调，而CLM扩展产生的增益较小且较不一致。总体而言，本研究提供了一个系统基准，用于量化配体数据可用性对残基级结合位点预测的影响，并评估对先前未见配体的泛化能力。

papers.title: CryoSHIELDs: tunable amphipathic peptide additives for cryo-EM
papers.translated_title: CryoSHIELDs：用于冷冻电镜的可调两亲性肽添加剂
papers.author: Azumaya, C. M.
papers.summary: While cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has transformed structural biology, sample preparation remains a major determinant of success. Specifically, the air-water interface (AWI) can damage complexes, impose preferred orientation, and reduce particle density. Here, we introduce cryoSHIELDs, a library of peptide additives designed to modulate the AWI and improve cryo-EM grid preparation. Across 24 diverse protein systems, cryoSHIELDs improved particle distribution, angular sampling, complex integrity, and, in selected cases, map quality and resolution. CryoSHIELDs enabled structure determination of the OSMR{beta}-Vixarelimab complex, the multi-subunit CCAN kinetochore complex without chemical cross-linking, and membrane proteins including ABCC6 and the -opioid receptor-Gi complex, the latter resolved at 2.3 A using tenfold lower protein concentration without compromising map quality. CryoSHIELDs provide a simple, tunable, and broadly applicable platform for more reliable cryo-EM in discovery biology and structure-based drug development.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）已经改变了结构生物学，但样品制备仍然是决定成功的主要因素。具体而言，空气-水界面（AWI）可能损伤复合物、造成优势取向并降低颗粒密度。在此，我们介绍了cryoSHIELDs，这是一个旨在调控AWI并改进冷冻电镜载网制备的肽添加剂文库。在24种不同的蛋白质体系中，cryoSHIELDs改善了颗粒分布、角度采样、复合物完整性，并在部分案例中提升了密度图质量和分辨率。cryoSHIELDs使得以下结构测定成为可能：OSMR{beta}-Vixarelimab复合物、未经化学交联的多亚基CCAN动粒复合物，以及包括ABCC6和μ-阿片受体-Gi复合物在内的膜蛋白，后者在蛋白质浓度降低十倍且不损害密度图质量的情况下以2.3 Å分辨率解析。cryoSHIELDs为发现生物学和基于结构的药物开发中更可靠的冷冻电镜提供了一个简单、可调且广泛适用的平台。

papers.title: The methionine cycle sustains the mesenchymal phenotype of tumor cells and drives PDA progression
papers.translated_title: 甲硫氨酸循环维持肿瘤细胞的间充质表型并驱动PDA进展
papers.author: Vasseur, S.
papers.summary: Mesenchymal traits are associated with poor prognosis in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDA), but direct targeting of mesenchymal tumor cells remains a challenge. Metabolic profiling of tumor cells isolated from murine PDA and liver metastases (LM) revealed that LM rely more on the methionine cycle than does primary PDA. This metabolic shift was specifically associated with increased activation of the methionine cycle in mesenchymal tumor cells compared to differentiated tumor cells. We show that the targeting of the key enzyme of the methionine cycle S-adenosylhomocysteine hydrolase (SAHH) in mesenchymal cells lowers the levels of homocysteine (Hcy) and glutathione, resulting in reduced antioxidant capacity, deregulated intracellular calcium homeostasis, and ultimately loss of mesenchymal markers. Together, these events decrease cell proliferation and invasion, blunting the tumorigenic and metastatic potential of SAHH-deficient cells, eventually impeding tumor growth and progression of the metastatic disease. Clinically, the high expression of SAHH in patients with mesenchymal PDA is correlated with poor survival, positioning SAHH as a potential therapeutic target to impede the pro-metastatic, mesenchymal phenotype of PDA.
papers.translated_summary: 间充质特征与胰腺导管腺癌（PDA）的不良预后相关，但直接靶向间充质肿瘤细胞仍是一项挑战。对从小鼠PDA和肝转移灶（LM）中分离的肿瘤细胞进行代谢谱分析显示，LM比原发PDA更依赖甲硫氨酸循环。这种代谢转变特异性地与间充质肿瘤细胞中甲硫氨酸循环活化增加相关，而非分化型肿瘤细胞。我们证明，靶向间充质细胞中甲硫氨酸循环的关键酶S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸水解酶（SAHH）可降低同型半胱氨酸（Hcy）和谷胱甘肽的水平，导致抗氧化能力下降、细胞内钙稳态失调，最终丧失间充质标志物。综合来看，这些事件降低了细胞增殖和侵袭能力，削弱了SAHH缺陷细胞的致瘤和转移潜能，最终阻碍肿瘤生长和转移性疾病的进展。在临床上，间充质型PDA患者中SAHH的高表达与不良生存相关，使SAHH成为阻碍PDA促转移间充质表型的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Extending the least-cost theory of stomatal regulation to include soil moisture stress
papers.translated_title: 将气孔调节的最小成本理论扩展至包含土壤水分胁迫
papers.author: Sandoval, D.
papers.summary: Terrestrial biosphere models commonly use empirical scaling factors to represent soil moisture constraints on carbon and water fluxes, but these lack mechanistic grounding and produce inconsistent estimates of soil moisture limitations on primary production and transpiration across models. Here we extended the least-cost hypothesis for optimal stomatal conductance to account for soil moisture limitations by allowing soil water availability to modulate the carbon cost of water transport, drawing on the observed temperature dependence of stem respiration, and derived a simple empirical approximation to the theory using global {delta}13C and eddy covariance data. The empirical analysis shows moderated thermal acclimation of stem respiration and a weak increase in water transport costs with aridity, supporting the interpretation that the decline in light-use efficiency (LUE) under arid conditions is primarily attributable to non-stomatal limitations. Validation against an independent global dataset of sapflow-derived canopy conductance and transpiration shows that the revised scheme significantly improves the predictive power of the least-cost hypothesis, offering a more mechanistically coherent alternative to existing soil moisture parameterisations.
papers.translated_summary: 陆地生物圈模型通常使用经验缩放因子来表示土壤水分对碳通量和水通量的限制，但这些因子缺乏机制基础，并且在不同模型之间对土壤水分限制初级生产量和蒸腾作用的估计不一致。在此，我们扩展了最优气孔导度的最小成本假说，通过允许土壤水可用性调节水分运输的碳成本来考虑土壤水分限制，借鉴了观测到的茎呼吸温度依赖性，并利用全球δ13C和涡度相关数据推导出该理论的一个简单经验近似。经验分析显示茎呼吸的热驯化有所缓和，水分运输成本随干旱度 weakly 增加，支持了干旱条件下光利用效率（LUE）下降主要归因于非气孔限制的解释。针对一个独立的全球数据集（由液流推导的冠层导度和蒸腾作用）进行验证表明，修订后的方案显著提高了最小成本假说的预测能力，为现有的土壤水分参数化方案提供了一种更具机制一致性的替代方案。

papers.title: Hierarchical organization in sparse gene regulatory networks shapes structural coherence and emergent regulatory coordination
papers.translated_title: 稀疏基因调控网络中的层次化组织塑造结构连贯性与涌现调控协调
papers.author: Harlapur, P.
papers.summary: A fundamental challenge in systems biology is understanding how regulatory coordination is maintained within extremely sparse gene regulatory networks (GRNs). While traditional unsigned network metrics can quantify the overall magnitude of influence a specific node or edge exerts over the network, they cannot predict the functional direction and consistency of these regulatory changes. To address this gap, we introduce the coherence matrix. This topology-based framework for signed, directed GRNs computes a strictly bounded, interpretable measure of directional regulatory coordination between gene pairs. Using synthetic network ensembles, we demonstrate that architectures with low intrinsic structural coherence suffer severe density-driven scaling penalties. Such structures cannot scale without requiring biologically unrealistic edge densities. Applying this framework to six whole-organism GRNs reveals how biological topologies overcome these limitations. Whole-organism GRNs exhibit lower overall coherence and more fragmented structures than expected, avoiding rigid global co-regulation to maximize regulatory degrees of freedom. Furthermore, these systems resolve the scaling penalties of complex, low-coherence architectures by restricting dense regulatory crosstalk to a compact intermediate core. Modeling synthetic hierarchical networks confirms that this architecture, a compact core within a globally feed-forward scaffold, neutralizes scaling penalties by minimizing nodes requiring dense connectivity. This allows GRNs to efficiently route decisions despite extreme sparsity. Finally, validation with transcriptomic data confirms that coherence matrix accurately predicts empirical co-regulation directionality. By moving beyond unsigned connectivity, the structural coherence framework provides a quantitative tool to map how the intrinsic behavior of localized interactions scales into macroscopic, system-wide coordination.
papers.translated_summary: 系统生物学的一个根本挑战在于理解极稀疏基因调控网络（GRNs）中调控协调是如何维持的。传统的无符号网络指标可以量化特定节点或边对网络的整体影响幅度，但无法预测这些调控变化的功能方向和一致性。为弥补这一空白，我们引入相干矩阵。这一基于拓扑的框架适用于有符号、有向的GRN，可计算基因对之间方向性调控协调的严格有界、可解释度量。利用合成网络集合，我们证明内在结构相干性低的架构会遭受严重的密度驱动缩放惩罚。此类结构若不具备生物学上不现实的边密度便无法扩展。将该框架应用于六个全生物体GRN，揭示了生物拓扑如何克服这些限制。全生物体GRN表现出比预期更低的整体相干性和更碎片化的结构，避免刚性的全局共调控以最大化调控自由度。此外，这些系统通过将密集调控串扰限制在紧凑的中间核心，解决了复杂低相干架构的缩放惩罚。对合成层级网络的建模证实，这种架构——全局前馈支架内的紧凑核心——通过最小化需要密集连接的节点来中和缩放惩罚。这使得GRN尽管极度稀疏，仍能高效地路由决策。最后，利用转录组数据进行的验证证实，相干矩阵能准确预测经验共调控的方向性。通过超越无符号连通性，结构相干性框架提供了一种定量工具，用以映射局部相互作用的内在行为如何缩放为宏观的、系统范围的协调。
